commitments.summaryEn: Compensate the full eligible monthly electricity bill through a distributor bill discount, without paper applications, for the principal residence of households eligible on actual income.
commitments.beneficiaries: Income-eligible households for their principal residence
commitments.scopeText: Compensate the full eligible monthly electricity bill through a distributor bill discount, without paper applications, for the principal residence of households eligible on actual income.
caveats: 100 MAD is an eligibility ceiling, not a universal flat payment or a cap on total electricity prices.

commitments.summaryEn: Reduce taxable income brackets from five to three, with progressive rates of 10%, 20% and 30%, and lower the top marginal rate from 37% to 30% while widening the base and combating evasion.
commitments.scopeText: Reduce taxable income brackets from five to three, with progressive rates of 10%, 20% and 30%, and lower the top marginal rate from 37% to 30% while widening the base and combating evasion.
caveats: The excerpt does not define the future boundaries of the three taxable brackets; do not invent them.

commitments.summaryEn: Progressively raise the first net-income exemption threshold from MAD 40,000 to MAD 60,000 after assessing household and public-revenue effects.
commitments.scopeText: Progressively raise the first net-income exemption threshold from MAD 40,000 to MAD 60,000 after assessing household and public-revenue effects.
caveats: The paragraph does not explicitly restate annual periodicity for the threshold.

commitments.summaryEn: Progressively raise minimum principal pensions across schemes to MAD 3,000 monthly through a clear financed timetable and periodic reviews.

target.unit: MAD per month main pension minimum

commitments.scopeText: Progressively raise minimum principal pensions across schemes to MAD 3,000 monthly through a clear financed timetable and periodic reviews.
caveats: No completion date is specified in the operative paragraph; do not treat it as an already applicable entitlement.

commitments.summaryEn: Progressively raise the monthly minimum direct assistance from MAD 500 to MAD 1,000 with financed programming, periodic review and impact measurement.
commitments.scopeText: Progressively raise the monthly minimum direct assistance from MAD 500 to MAD 1,000 with financed programming, periodic review and impact measurement.
